description:
About the Team

The Dasher & Logistics team is responsible for ensuring every delivery is completed with speed, accuracy and a positive Consumer, Merchant and Dasher experience. Dasher & Logistics owns initiatives that touch all parts of the Dasher life cycle ranging from supply & demand, to cost & quality, to Dasher pay, to Dasher retention, to order batching and beyond. We care about metrics like delivery times, cost per order, delivery quality, dasher compensation, and many more! 

About the Role

We are hiring an Associate Manager to help lead strategy and execution for our Dasher & Logistics regulatory markets, the growing set of cities, states, and countries where Dasher pay, benefits, and working conditions are shaped by minimum earnings guarantees, pay transparency requirements, and other logistics specific regulation. You'll own a portfolio of KRs across some of our highest priority business problems by getting into the weeds to understand what's happening on the ground, using data and customer insights to identify opportunities, developing and testing hypotheses, and partnering cross-functionally to bring solutions to life at scale. You will report directly to a Senior Manager on the Dasher & Logistics team.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own a portfolio of KRs across our regulatory markets, setting the strategy and building the execution plan to hit your goals 
  • Use a data-driven approach to investigate problems, creating insightful analysis from a combination of quantitative and qualitative information, and implement next steps 
  • Operate at the lowest level of detail in order to build strong foundational knowledge of your problem space and provide recommendations for leadership 
  • Define and test hypotheses through experimentation, leverage AI to accelerate learnings, and scale successful strategies across the org 
  • Work cross-functionally across multiple teams to drive alignment and impact, such as Legal, Public Policy, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Marketing
  • Develop new skills and advance your career, with opportunities to take on new challenges and responsibilities as you progress in your role

We’re excited about you because…

  • You have 5-7 years of experience in startups, strategy, consulting, financial services, operations, technology, AI, regulatory, or related experience
  • You are able to analyze and synthesize data, make informed decisions and balance quantitative measurement with an empathetic, intuition-based mindset. You can crunch data in SQL/excel independently and are comfortable owning ambiguous, fast-moving problems with legal and financial stakes
  • You actively look for ways AI can make your work better, using tools like Claude or Cursor to move faster from data to decision
  • You focus on getting stuff done and aren’t afraid to get into the details. No job is beneath you and you lead from the front and with optimism
  • You love thinking about problems from a first principles approach, and you aren't afraid to take action and try new things in order to create the future, while knowing when to bring in the right partners on higher-stakes decisions
  • You are able to communicate complex topics in a clear and concise way to stakeholders at all levels of the organization and get alignment
  • You have experience managing cross-functional workstreams or a strong desire to grow into that responsibility
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in a related field 

We expect this position to be filled by 23/11/2026

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$87,000—$128,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

description:
PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

 

About the Role

PagerDuty is seeking a Principal Product Manager, Platform Security to own the strategy and execution of how we secure, harden, and defend our Operations Cloud platform. This role sits within our Product Development organization and reports to the Sr Director of Product, Platform & Partners.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll bring the same rigor to security that a great PM brings to a product: deep customer empathy, structured threat modeling, clear risk tiering frameworks, and a bias toward measurable outcomes. You'll also be the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, IT, and Legal, ensuring security strategy translates into engineering execution and customer trust. This role owns the full lifecycle from recommendation to implementation to operations. You'll be the decision-maker on risk acceptance, control exceptions, and incident escalation in real-time.

The ideal candidate has operated at the intersection of product management and security engineering in a later-stage B2B SaaS environment. You've owned security architecture decisions end-to-end, built security infrastructure, and have the credibility to influence both product roadmaps and engineering practices without formal authority.

What You'll Own

Product & Platform Security

  • Define and evolve PagerDuty's platform identity and security architecture — trust boundaries, authentication and authorization models, and secrets management frameworks
  • Admin experience and admin console for enterprise and security administrators
  • Build and maintain a security review process so product teams bring security into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought
  • Own the security platform roadmap 
  • Provide security and secure-design leadership to other product teams across the portfolio

What You'll Build

This role owns a portfolio of platform security surfaces that includes:

  • Identity & Permissions platform — the authentication and authorization foundation for both human users and AI agents, spanning roles, scopes, and delegated access as agentic workflows become first-class actors on the platform
  • Security products — customer-facing capabilities such as IP Allow list and SCIM, extending the set of controls enterprise customers need to adopt PagerDuty at scale
  • Admin experience — the tooling administrators use to configure, audit, and govern their PagerDuty environment, with opportunity to improve clarity and self-service
  • Partner security and governance — the shared services, primitives, and audit surfaces that every partner team builds on
  • Partner with executive leadership to align security strategy with company-level trust and resilience targets

The opportunity is to bring these surfaces together into a coherent platform so security decisions and actions happen faster, customers can govern their own environments with confidence, and product teams have primitives they trust and actively build on.

 

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in B2B SaaS in roles spanning product management, security engineering, and/or platform security
  • Demonstrated experience owning security architecture and risk tiering decisions — not just supporting them
  • Track record of running security programs and measuring risk reduction impact
  • Strong cross-functional credibility with Engineering, Legal, Product, and Go-To-Market leadership
  • Experience managing security change in the field — migrations, re-architecture, new authentication and authorization models — with the communication skills to bring stakeholders along
  • Ability to mentor other product managers and raise the security bar across a product organization without direct reports

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a company during transition to zero-trust or hardened multi-tenant isolation architecture
  • Familiarity with security infrastructure (IAM, secrets management, vulnerability and posture tooling)
  • Familiarity with B2B SaaS compliance frameworks, customer security review processes, and audit considerations

Compensation

The base salary range for this position in the US is 180,000 - 303,600 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

 

Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.

Hesitant to apply?

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions:
Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site.

Your package may include:

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package 
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Company equity*
  • ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*
  • Retirement or pension plan*
  • Generous paid vacation time
  • Paid holidays and sick leave
  • Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO
  • Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*
  • Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year
  • Company-wide hack weeks
  • Mental wellness programs

*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses

PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2. 

Go behind-the-scenes on our careers site and @pagerduty on Instagram.

Additional Information

PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's Privacy Policy.

PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

PagerDuty uses the E-Verify employment verification program.

description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

The Team

Pinterest's Ads Delivery Infrastructure team builds and operates the real-time serving, indexing, retrieval, and budgeting systems that power Shopping and Ads at Pinterest. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com. About the Role We are seeking a Staff Monetization and Pricing Strategist to build Bonterra's first dedicated pricing function. This is a senior individual-contributor role (no direct reports at launch), and you'll own the discipline end to end: willingness-to-pay research, value metric design, packaging architecture, and AI pricing methodologies across a SaaS product portfolio and a fast-growing AI product line. You won't simply be inheriting a pre-built function to maintain or administrate. You're coming in to assess what's already there, decide what to keep and what to rebuild, then stand up the strategy and cadence from the ground up. You will partner closely with senior leaders across Bonterra to get a baseline of current SaaS product and AI financial metrics, assess the Pricing Committee and governance structure, and align our pricing strategy to the annual operating plan goals for 2027 and beyond. You'll be the first hire into a new pricing function, reporting directly to the CPO, who has direct experience with pricing strategy from PwC, startups, and PE software companies. You won't be evangelizing pricing discipline into a skeptical org, and you won't be handed a playbook to simply execute either. You're stepping into an executive room that's already bought into the importance of this work, and you'll have full latitude to shape what comes next. You own the strategy, the governance model, and the cadence going forward, not just the execution of decisions someone else already made. You will have investments in the proper tools to succeed. In this role, you will: Own willingness-to-pay research and value metric design for Bonterra Que (our AI-powered product suite that turns a customer's own fragmented data into actionable insights and recommendations, and a fast-growing part of our business) and for the broader product portfolio (Case Management, Fundraising Solutions, Fundraising Experiences, Corporate Social Responsibility, and Payments). Build the pricing research methodology at Bonterra: conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp, and value-based pricing frameworks applied to a real, in-flight portfolio, not a greenfield exercise. We will then turn the findings into actionable decisions for our products. Design packaging architecture including tier definitions, feature gating, bundle logic for current products as well as new Que AI skills coming to market. Build and maintain competitive pricing intelligence against key competitors in the market, while also pulling from new approaches to AI pricing from high growth AI companies out of market. Deliver the first annual pricing benchmark study for Bonterra, based on internal performance against a SaaS peer set, built to be board-ready. Provide a pricing input on every new product investment proposal before it's approved, making revenue forecast projections a scored dimension within our business case structure. Partner directly with the CPO on Pricing Committee strategic reviews and represent pricing methodology at a senior level across Product, Finance, and Commercial. Responsibilities Pricing Strategy & Research Own willingness-to-pay studies for new SKUs, packaging changes, and Que monetization, starting with the Que willingness-to-pay study targeted for this year. Define value metrics by category (per donor, per giving volume, per record, per insight): the foundation that drives durable net revenue retention, not just initial price point. Own packaging architecture: tier definitions, feature gating, and bundle design across the portfolio. Build and maintain the competitive pricing intelligence function. AI & Que Monetization Lead the monetization architecture for Bonterra Que, the highest-leverage pricing question in the portfolio: standardize attach motion, value metric, and bundle math across related product portfolios. Partner with Product leaders to ensure pricing keeps pace with capabilities, as this is a fast-evolving product, and the pricing model has to move with it, not lag behind it. You'll own the analysis, strategy, and transition plan from current pricing structures to usage-based and outcome-based pricing for Que. You will be the primary change agent for taking us from a set of traditional SaaS pricing models to AI-first monetization. Cross-Functional Influence Deliver pricing input to every new product investment proposal before it's approved: willingness-to-pay becomes a scored dimension in the review, not a footnote. Partner with the CPO to run Pricing Committee strategic reviews (quarterly tactical, annual strategic). Partner with the Finance organization on operating-plan-aligned pricing performance inputs. Align to EBITDA and margin goals set with our executive team. Partner with the Commercial organization on competitive pricing intelligence feeding deal desk and discount governance. Coordinate with the active SKU and Pricing Operations workstream to ensure new pricing architecture lands cleanly in the operational system of record. Qualifications You are: A pricing methodologist, not a spreadsheet operator. You've run conjoint analysis, Van Westendorp, and value-based pricing studies and can defend the methodology to a CFO and a customer in the same week. Comfortable formalizing something distributed, not building from a blank page. The basics already exist today: a discount framework, embedded pricing partners across the business, a Pricing Committee charter. What's missing is the rigor, the methodology, and the scale. You'll design the first formal value metric framework and competitive intelligence process, building on what's already there rather than starting from zero. Fluent in where AI pricing is actually headed , not just the traditional SaaS playbook of the last decade. You know the difference between usage-based and outcome-based, when each earns its keep, and how to move a portfolio from one to the other without breaking trust. Que monetization is the single highest-leverage question you'll own. A strong cross-functional operator. You will actively work with our CPO, CFO, CRO, and CEO on the pricing strategy and execution, adjusting the framing for each without changing the substance. Comfortable operating without a team at launch. As an individual contributor, you'll build the methodology first; the org grows around what you prove out. Reqiurements: 6+ years in pricing strategy, either in-house at a multi-product B2B SaaS company or in a pricing strategy consulting practice (Simon-Kucher, McKinsey Pricing, BCG, OpenView, etc). Demonstrated ownership of a willingness-to-pay study from design through pricing decision, not just participation in one. Experience designing value metrics and packaging for a multi-product or multi-segment portfolio. Exposure to usage-based and outcome-based AI pricing models, and a point of view on when to graduate from one to the other: this is a strong plus given Que's trajectory. Comfort operating in a PE-backed environment where pricing discipline is a named valuation lever. You've successfully: Led a willingness-to-pay or value-based pricing study that changed a real pricing decision, not just informed a deck. Built a competitive pricing intelligence process from scratch and kept it current enough to be trusted. Partnered with Product and Engineering leadership to translate pricing strategy into packaging and feature-gating decisions that shipped. Operated as an individual contributor with senior-level influence, shaping executive decisions without a team behind you. If you're a pricing leader who wants to build the methodological foundation for how a mission-driven AI-native SaaS company monetizes, and who believes pricing is a product discipline, not a finance afterthought, we want to meet you. At Bonterra, we’re building AI-powered tools to solve real human challenges—and we want teammates who share that enthusiasm. You will also contribute to the growth of NGP VAN Interface MCP solution and the underlying NGP VAN API, ensuring the platform can support an ever-expanding list of agentic use cases. This is a client-facing technical role that demands a combination of strong engineering instincts, genuine political and civic ecosystem fluency, and the interpersonal skills to earn trust with campaigns and organizers who may be encountering AI for the first time. Essential Functions Embed on-site or remotely with client organizations (campaigns, parties, nonprofits, ISVs, consulting firms) to understand their existing workflows and identify high-value opportunities for agentic AI automation. Lead workflow discovery sessions with client stakeholders to map processes, surface pain points, and co-develop a prioritized roadmap of agentifiable workflows. Design and build agentic skills atop NGP VAN and the NGP VAN Interface, translating client workflow requirements into reliable, maintainable skill implementations that integrate with the broader Claude/AI agent ecosystem. Manage the full skill delivery lifecycle from requirements gathering through design, build, testing, deployment, and iteration — functioning as a one-person product and engineering team for each client engagement. description:
About the Role

At DoorDash we are redefining what it means to be a designer. We are building towards a team of makers, builders, and doers. Between 2005 and 2015, "web designer" became "product designer" and the scope widened. The same shift is happening now — LLMs are expanding the T again, toward strategy on one end and direct execution on the other. As a Staff Product Designer, you will lead this shift across your team: not just practicing build-first design, but multiplying it through the people and systems around you.

We're seeking an ambitious and system design minded Staff Product Designer to lead “Meals for Work” within DoorDash for Business, a strategic area at the heart of redefining workplace dining and company perks. You’ll craft transformative consumer and enterprise experiences, from tools that make team lunch ordering effortless to scalable solutions for catering, company paid recurring meals, and grocery benefits. This role offers a unique opportunity to design powerful systems that help workplace admins plan, manage, and operate food programs with confidence, while pioneering new offerings in an evolving market.

This position is open for candidates in San Francisco, Seattle, or New York City, and will report to the Head of New Bets Design within our Consumer organization. You will work in a hybrid model, working from one of our offices 1-2 times a week with the rest working from home. 

Your primary impact is making the team faster and more autonomous. You build reusable workflows, shared tools, and decision frameworks that let every designer on your team operate at a higher level with less coordination overhead. Your secondary impact is revenue: the speed and quality gains you unlock translate directly into more experiments shipped, faster iteration cycles, and measurable business outcomes across your team and adjacent teams.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Define projects with a clear point of view on what to build, writing briefs that synthesize business and customer inputs into roadmap milestones; balance customer needs, business goals, and feasibility to shape what your team builds and why
  • Bring clarity to ambiguous, cross-team problems and turn them into actionable work that ships; drive prioritization across your team and adjacent teams, making tradeoffs between design quality, speed, and impact so the highest-leverage work moves first
  • Shape key projects from concept through execution — staying close enough to resolve issues during iteration, guiding design direction, and shipping work that drives measurable outcomes across multiple teams; produce high-fidelity designs and production-ready prototypes that set the craft standard for the team
  • Design solutions spanning multiple workflows and contribute to shared tools — prompt libraries, component generators, workflow automations — that improve productivity across teams; mentor peers on responsible AI use and contribute reusable frameworks adopted beyond your own team
  • Build trusted relationships across your team and adjacent product teams, influencing their roadmaps through evidence-based thinking and live prototypes that make your recommendations concrete; pursue consistent self-improvement and flex into raising team outcomes
  • Multiply team capacity through mentorship, recruiting, and inclusive practices that raise the bar across your product group

We're excited about you because...

  • You have a portfolio that shows projects that demonstrate craft excellence, systems thinking, and leadership through influence
  • You reach for code editors and LLM-powered tools as naturally as design tools, prototyping in production and contributing meaningfully to the codebase
  • You influence, design, and build solutions that work across teams and workflows
  • You enjoy navigating unclear problems across multiple teams and create clarity through shipped artifacts, not slide decks 

Compensation

The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.  Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay ranges for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We monetize primarily through advertising, helping millions of businesses connect with high-intent consumers. The Ads Auction system sits at the heart of this exchange, determining which ads are shown for every opportunity. The Ads Market Dynamics team is responsible for the core engine that drives Yelp's advertising business. We develop and optimize the sophisticated auction, bidding, and pacing systems that balance advertiser value (ROI), consumer experience, and Yelp's monetization goals. We work at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and large-scale systems engineering. As the Principal Product Manager for Ads Auction and Measurement, you will own the product strategy and execution for Yelp's core ad auction, bidding, pricing, budget pacing mechanisms, and corresponding measurements. This is a highly technical leadership role where you will guide the evolution of algorithms and systems that make real-time decisions maximizing value across multiple stakeholders. You will define how we measure the performance and impact of these complex systems, focusing on both short-term efficiency and long-term impact. You will partner closely with world-class engineering and applied science teams to design, experiment, implement, and iterate on auction dynamics and the metrics that guide our progress. This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular state within the US. We welcome applicants from throughout the US. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes. What you'll do: Auction Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the product roadmap for Yelp's ads auction, bidding algorithms, pricing mechanisms, and budget pacing systems, ensuring alignment with business objectives and competitive dynamics. Identify key levers for optimization and innovation. Algorithm & System Optimization: Partner deeply with Engineering and Data Science to design, develop, and refine the auction-based ad selection system. Translate advertiser goals (ROI, leads, conversions), user experience, and monetization considerations into algorithmic requirements, and prioritize initiatives based on concrete data and expected impact. Auction Measurement & Evaluation: Define and own the key metrics framework for evaluating auction health, efficiency, and the business impact. Drive the development of robust measurement for complex trade-offs (e.g., relevance vs. monetization, short-term vs. long-term effects). Design and interpret large-scale A/B tests. Independent Data Analysis: Conduct hands-on analysis of large-scale auction and advertising datasets using tools like SQL and Python to uncover optimization opportunities, validate hypotheses, understand performance drivers, and inform product decisions. Technical Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for auction-related features and improvements, from ideation and requirements definition through launch and iteration. Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the product leader for the auction domain, collaborating effectively with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Finance, and other Product teams. Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences. Drive Business Impact: Directly influence Yelp's revenue and advertiser success by improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the core ad marketplace. What it takes to succeed: Experience: 8+ years of technical product management experience, preferably focused on auctions, bidding systems, search ranking, or monetization platforms within the online advertising (AdTech) industry. Auction & Optimization Expertise: Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience with auction theory (e.g., VCG, GSP), optimization algorithms, statistical modeling, and machine learning concepts relevant to ad targeting and ranking. Advanced Analytical & Data Skills: Proven ability to independently query, manipulate, and analyze large, complex datasets. Proficiency with SQL and data analysis tools/languages (e.g., Python, R) is required. Statistical Rigor: Deep understanding of applied statistics, experimental design (A/B testing), causal inference, and methods for measuring statistical significance and inferring long-term impact. Educational Background: Strong quantitative background; Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Mathematics, or a related field is highly preferred. Technical Fluency: Ability to engage deeply with engineers and data scientists on technical details of algorithms, system design, and data infrastructure. Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across various functions. Problem Solving: Strong structured thinking and problem-solving abilities, capable of breaking down complex problems into actionable components. description: Kiosk mode AI Operations Lead, Toast IQ Engineering AI Operations Lead, Toast IQ R14741 Remote Remote, United States Add to favorites View favorites Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. About the Role: Toast IQ is our agentic platform for local business: a growing set of specialized AI agents and capabilities designed to take real work off an operator’s plate, from driving demand and managing labor to optimizing the back office. As we expand this portfolio across multiple lines of business, we need to ensure that what we build comes together as a coherent platform, reaches the market effectively, and produces meaningful customer and business impact. The AI Operations Lead will help build and run the operating system that connects AI strategy to execution and market impact. You will help shape how our AI portfolio comes together, is launched, and adopted, building the operating engine that brings this experience to life, and turning customer, market, and technology signals into better product and commercial decisions. This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with the VP of Product for Toast IQ, partnering across product, design, engineering, marketing, sales, and support to bring the vision of Toast IQ to life. Success will require strong judgment, exceptional communication, and the ability to personally drive ambiguous work to completion. A day in the life (Responsibilities) Create visibility across Toast’s broader AI efforts and run portfolio ops. Connect work happening across the agent portfolio and other AI initiatives. Share learnings, identify opportunities to reuse capabilities, and surface key decisions. Maintain visibility into ownership, sequencing, dependencies, key decisions, risks, progress, and enablement. Build Toast’s AI presence. Partner with product, design, engineering, and marketing to make Toast’s AI products, technical insights, customer outcomes, and talent more visible through launches, customer stories, product and engineering content, and social channels both internally and externally. Turn high-impact ideas into action . Identify opportunities to accelerate Toast’s AI strategy, develop a strong point of view on what we should do, and have the ownership to run at the best ideas, bringing the right people together and driving the work from concept to tangible outcome Help shape the AI portfolio strategy. Partner with product and business leaders to define target customers, priority use cases, positioning, packaging, sequencing, and launch plans across Toast’s AI portfolio. Build an AI-powered engine that gets smarter over time. Use AI to continuously synthesize customer insights, product performance, market shifts, and changes in the underlying technology, turning signals from across the business into actions that improve our products, priorities, and how we bring them to customers. Turn a fast-moving AI market into an advantage. Stay up on what’s happening in AI and help translate emerging patterns into implications for Toast’s strategy What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) Fluent with AI products, including how they work and what patterns are leading within B2B and consumer markets. 5+ years of experience in product operations, business operations, go-to-market strategy, or product marketing, with experience working alongside product and engineering teams. Demonstrated ownership of complex or emerging products from development through launch, internal enablement, customer adoption, and ongoing market learning. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex information into a clear narrative for customers, go-to-market teams, and senior leaders. Track record of building repeatable, cross-functional operating models. Strong product and commercial judgment, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into clear customer value and compelling market narratives. Ability to move fluidly between strategy and execution, from shaping a portfolio narrative or launch plan to improving a demo, creating enablement, resolving a readiness gap, or synthesizing customer feedback. Strong analytical skills and experience defining the measures that indicate whether a launch is working. High judgment and comfort operating in ambiguity. You recognize what matters, make defensible decisions, surface the right questions, and personally drive work to completion What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves) Experience bringing AI/ML, agentic, platform, or other rapidly evolving technical products to market. Experience building a launch, commercialization, or adoption motion. Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where the role required significant range and adaptability. Experience developing customer proof, product demonstrations, or technical thought leadership. Vertical SaaS, SMB, or restaurant and hospitality technology experience. Familiarity with AI product evaluation and the commercial considerations associated with AI products. BA/BS or equivalent practical experience AI at Toast At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
